    03 — BEFORE YOU SIGN

    Six things we check before you sign.

    Six points we put in writing on every contract.

    I
    The deposit cap2 months max

    Dutch law caps the deposit at two months' rent. Agents still ask for three. We don't let them.

    II
    RegistrationBRP · BSN

    A landlord cannot forbid registration at the address. No BRP, no BSN, no bank. We confirm it in writing before you pay.

    III
    The points systemWWS

    Many Amsterdam homes fall under the points system. An asking rent above the legal maximum is leverage. We run the check.

    IV
    Service costsservicekosten

    "€1,800 + €250 service costs" often hides charges the law does not allow. We separate legitimate from padding.

    V
    Contract typesince 2024

    Since 2024 the default contract is indefinite. Fixed-term offers are the exception, with conditions. We check which one you are handed.

    VI
    Income ruleson paper

    New job, freelance, non-euro salary: each has a right way to be presented. We write it so a Dutch landlord reads it as safe.

    We'll also tell you what's wrong with it.

    A tenancy that goes wrong costs us more than a lost fee — so we write down what we saw, before you sign.

    ⚑asking rent above the WWS maximum ⚑a three-month deposit ⚑service costs that are padding ⚑no registration at the address
    04 — QUESTIONS

    The questions we get asked.

    Isn't it illegal for agents to charge tenants in the Netherlands?
    It is illegal for an agent to charge you when they also act for the landlord — what most "free" agencies do. An agent you hire, who works only for you, may charge you for the work. That is what we are.
    Which service is mine?
    Full Search (€500) if you haven't started. Application Pack (€199) if you've found one and need to apply, or you have a shortlist and you're already in Amsterdam. Attended Viewing (€149 per viewing) if you have a shortlist and you're still abroad. Not sure: open a file, we advise.
    How fast will I have an apartment?
    Budget and move-in date decide it. A complete Dutch-format dossier and applications inside the hour are what shorten it. Nobody can promise a date in Amsterdam. Anyone who does is selling you something else.
    Do I need to be in Amsterdam?
    No. A BOOM person attends viewings in your place, with live video and a written report. The contract is checked and signed remotely. You arrive for the keys and the BRP appointment.
    What if you don't find anything?
    Then we talk. We say in the first call if your budget and timeline don't fit the market, and we would rather decline a search than take one we don't believe in — if we decline, Full Search is refunded in full.
    How do I pay?
    By card on this page (Stripe) when you start, or by bank transfer against an invoice from Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l. Flat fees, VAT included. Nothing from landlords, their agents or platforms.
    I'm moving from Rome with BOOM. Does my file carry over?
    Yes. Your documents are already in the portal. We convert them to the Dutch format the same day.
    What do you do with my data?
    It is used to answer you and to run your search, and for nothing else. No resale, no mailing lists. Ask us to delete it and we will.

    Who
    BOOM Amsterdam, the tenant-side rental desk of BOOM — operated by Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l., a registered Italian agency. In the Netherlands the role is called aanhuurmakelaar: hired by the tenant, paid by the tenant only.
    For whom
    Internationals relocating to Amsterdam — employees, researchers, couples and families — from abroad or already in the city.
    Fees
    Full Search €500 · Application Pack €199 · Attended Viewing €149 per viewing. VAT included. No percentage of the rent, nothing from landlords or platforms.
    What we do
    Dutch-format dossier in 24 hours, applications within the hour, attended viewings with live video and written report, negotiation, contract check against Dutch law, BRP confirmed in writing.
    What we don't do
    We don't list homes, we don't represent landlords, we don't promise a date.

    The same working day.
